conditions: Signed-in administrator navigates to the admin product list page
items.expected: The admin product list page loads successfully; each product row shows the product's name and price

conditions: Administrator types a product name fragment into the search field and submits
items.expected: The search is accepted; only products whose names match the search term are shown in the list

conditions: Administrator searches the admin product list by a known product name
items.expected: The search action completes; the list narrows to show only products matching the search term

conditions: A signed-in customer account (non-admin) navigates directly to the admin product list URL
items.expected: The customer is redirected away from the admin page; the admin product list is not shown

conditions: An unauthenticated visitor navigates directly to the admin product list URL
items.expected: The visitor is redirected away from the admin page; no admin product data is visible

conditions: Administrator is on the admin product list page
items.expected: axe-core finds no WCAG A/AA violations in the admin product list (violations.map(v => v.id).sort() equals [])

excluded.reason: TOOL-20 is about the billing address step not being filled from the customer profile — a checkout concern unrelated to the admin product list covered by this story
